steps.note: S1.1.1.1 gives the row-by-row subtract, change, add, restore sequence and concludes y gets y+(JV+RG)x for every initial a,c, matching the paper.
S1.1.1.2 states the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side wires cancelling exactly the intersection-one pairs, intersections 0 and 2 already zero, and self coefficient one.
The plan treats only the bit case; nowhere does it give the complex-case central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 or the side cancellation of intersections zero and two.
S1.1.1.3 gives (x,y) -> (x,y+x) -> (-y,y+x) -> (-y,x) from forward, inverse, forward stages, each invocation restoring its own scratch wires.
The plan never gives the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions (the residual table); S1.1.3.3 and S1.1.3.6 only say edges join comparable/nested labels.

S1.1.3.2 states only the inclusion P(x)<t_X> in P(x)t_Y^perp from t_X perp t_Y (the label construction, paper line 953); the side edge 2->5 residual, the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp and its dimension h-2 are not stated.
S1.1.3.3 names center 3->4 as the only decreasing edge losing h, and S1.1.3.4 gives the telescoping to sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N and absolute Wm-2N+2L.
The plan never argues that the binary residuals are nondegenerate and nonalternating or that they admit an orthonormal basis; S2.1 and S2.1.1 merely assume an orthonormal basis of the residual.
S1.1.3.5 states L_b/N=100/539 and S2.1.2 states L_c/N=101/539.
S2.1.1 states weight additive mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors (via even intersection) and q_V-q_U = sum over an orthonormal basis of wt(v)[v.x], with the quote placed in that role.

S2.1.1 only asserts that each odd-weight v contributes a kernel aI+bX_v or its inverse; the phase form i^{eps[v.x]} and the identity H diag(1,-1) H = X that turns it into a translation are not stated (borderline: result asserted without its derivation).

S2.1.3 and S2.1.5 state that each residual basis vector gives exactly one factor (a forward child on all f columns/axes) and that there are s_c in total; the tensor-power-over-columns step is not written out but the content is the same.

The plan names the Z signs, scalar i^{27f}, negation of X outputs and C=iZC^{-1}Z (S2.1 method, S2.1.5) but never states that zero label has frame I and full label C^{tensor m}, nor that X_a->Y_a carries C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) which the Z repair fixes.
S1.1.3.5 says the loss ratio is below 1/2 and S1.1.3.6 gives s_b short of W_b m by N-2L_b>0.
The value eta_c = 73/19906842167500 does not appear anywhere in the plan; S2.1.2 gives only the sign of the complex deficit 2N-2L_c>0.

S1.1.4 gives deficit > 20*2^-50, log m<20, m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20*2^-50) and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^-50 (using the paper's 'both deficits' quote), and S5.1.1 gives tau=sigma=1-2^-50; the explicit numerical statement is for the bit deficit only.

S1.1.5.1 states A=E1 Pi E2 with invertible lower-triangular E1,E2 and Pi with exactly a ones, found by eliminating with the rightmost entry of the topmost nonzero row as pivot; the repetition on active indices is only implicit (borderline).

S1.1.5 mentions only 'q a fixed prime avoiding all denominators' in its statement; the finite table of factors, the specialization of the rational identities to Z/q^b and invertibility of the triangular factors there are not stated.
S1.1.5.2 states a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order, each from earlier coordinates still holding original values.
S1.1.5.3 gives the sequence D_j+=H_i, interchange, D_j=H_i-D_j taking (h,d) to (h+d,d) with one interchange, so a ones give a interchanges.
The plan never defines E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu, C_0=128mB^2 or Delta beyond the bare ceiling expression; S2.5 only uses C_0 d^{C_1} and C_1=20 without definitions.

The plan has no arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at internal nodes, A(e)<=8e at leaves, or the per-invocation count below E; S2.5 asserts the depth bound C_0 d^{C_1} outright, and the only recurrences are the time recurrences F.
The unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu and A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} leading to the total below C_0 d^{C_1} is not in the plan; S2.5 asserts the final depth bound without it.

S2.5 states values at depth j lie in 2^{-(p+j)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^j and that p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits hold every intermediate value exactly with Delta=o(p); epsilon*C_1<1 appears only in S5.1.1 and is not linked to Delta=o(p) in S2.5 (borderline).
S2.6 states every row of H has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved, and the single truncation changes each component by less than 2^-p, giving error below sqrt2*2^-p.
